chapter: Dance jobs and the opera house
title: The Silver Slipper and the forgotten theater on Rampart
summary: Piron directed Dejan's band at the Silver Slipper (the Dream Room on Bourbon); the interviewer asks about a small theater on Rampart, which Dejan cannot recall.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: When you talk about Opera House, well, you're going to say something about a theater. You mean the old French Opera House? Yeah, but other people, I wanted to ask, this is interrupting and changing the subject again, that theater over here on Rampart Street. I forgot the name of that thing. You mean what Schumann had when I was playing Piran?
That's before you. Yeah, I played at the Silver Slipper, you mean that's, Yeah, I guess that's. Because Piran was directing my band at the Silver Slipper.
Where was the Silver Slipper then? Was there on the Rampart?

Right there, right, no, the Silver Slipper's on Boyleburn. The Bourbon, the one, yeah. See, right where, what's the name of that, where, where, where, where, the Dixieland band. That's the Dream Room. Dream Room, that's right, that was the Silver Slipper. Well, what about this theater? I might have one of those Silver Slippers home, no, they used to give us silver in there. I didn't know I had it for many years.
What was this theater on Rampart Street? Somebody else told me once, but we don't have anything about it in there.
I forgot the name of it, yeah.
I mean, where was it, do you remember?
The theater, what, what, what, what Schumann Hall, you mean? What, the matter is, I was playing by the Silver Slipper?

Yeah, I mean, what was that little theater? Was it a, was it ever a dance hall first or something? Well, I don't, no, I don't think so. Seems like somebody told me that once was a little French theater, and then it later became a dance hall, or maybe it had been a dance hall and they turned it into a theater. Well, I, that's beyond me, no.
You don't remember anything about that.
That's beyond me, no. Something like that, no, that went on, I forget what it is. No, I don't remember that. We'll find somebody on, tell us someday.
